user.title: Connect Solariance
user.description: Paste a personal API token. Create one at {token_url} (Account → API tokens); read-only is enough.

data_description.api_token: The token is checked by listing your systems.

system.title: Choose a system
system.description: Each Solariance system becomes its own entry. Add the integration again for another system.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Solariance refused the stored token (revoked or expired). Paste a new one from {token_url}.

error.invalid_auth: Solariance refused this token. Check that it was copied completely and is still active.
error.cannot_connect: Solariance could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
error.rate_limited: Your account's hourly request limit is used up. Try again later.
error.no_systems: This account has no PV system yet. Create one in the Solariance app first.
error.system_not_in_account: This token belongs to an account without this system.

abort.already_configured: Every system of this account is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: The forecast changes with each weather model run, a few times a day. Free and Plus accounts share 30 forecast requests per hour with the Solariance app.

rate_limited.message: The account's hourly request limit is used up; the forecast is fetched again when it resets.

system_paused.message: Solariance has paused this system because your plan does not cover it (more systems or a larger system than the plan allows). Change your plan or remove a system at solariance.de; the forecast is checked again hourly.

no_forecast_yet.message: Solariance has not computed a forecast for this system yet.

unreadable_forecast.message: Solariance answered with a forecast this integration cannot read.

entry_not_found.message: No Solariance entry with the ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: {name} has no forecast loaded right now.

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Returns the forecast of a Solariance system as response data.

day.name: Day
day.description: 0 = today, 1 = tomorrow, … Leave empty for every day available.

find_surplus_window.name: Find surplus window
find_surplus_window.description: Finds the time window in which a load is covered best by the forecast solar surplus, e.g. to start a dishwasher or charge a car.

load_kw.name: Load
load_kw.description: Power the device draws while running.

baseline_kw.name: Base load
baseline_kw.description: What the home draws anyway; only power above it counts as surplus.

day.name: Day
day.description: 0 = today (only windows that have not started), 1 = tomorrow, …

feed_in_tariff_eur_per_kwh.name: Feed-in tariff
feed_in_tariff_eur_per_kwh.description: Optional: subtracted from the price for the saving.
